instances.claim: This tells me that collectors decide which Cents matter on the basis of the marks of touch and time — that wear is the criterion of value within the set.
instances.why: Line 18 states a property (the once-identical Cents now differ by handling), and line 19 immediately states a selection being made; the adjacency supplies the missing premise that the property is the ground of the selection. Nothing in the draft says what the set's 'logics and rarities' (17) actually are, so the criterion is manufactured entirely by the order.
